notes.title: X3: Reunion featured in Steam's 20th Anniversary Event
notes.notes:
Steam is celebrating its monumental [b]20th anniversary[/b] with a special event that kicks off today. To pay homage to its rich history and the gamers who have used the platform, Steam has set up a special landing page. This space is designed to take visitors on a nostalgic journey through the past two decades, highlighting the games that have captivated audiences year after year. Among these memorable titles is our very own [b]X3: Reunion, one of Steam's best-selling games of 2006[/b].

To get X3: Reunion into shape for this celebration, we have invested time and effort in refreshing the game specifically for this event.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2810/X3_Reunion/

To further entice both newcomers and long-time fans of the series, an 80% discount on X3: Reunion will be available from September 12 to September 19.

While we've got your attention, it's worth highlighting the ongoing development of the latest instalment, [b]X4: Foundations[/b]. Since its original release in 2018, the game has undergone numerous updates and expansions. The current version, 6.20, offers a wealth of content and gameplay enhancements that reflect our commitment to evolving the series while maintaining its core elements.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/392160/X4_Foundations/

Thanks for your support, and enjoy the Steam 20th Anniversary celebration!

[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[list][*]Added support for wider range of resolutions.
[*]Added default controller layout for keyboard/mouse emulation via Steam Input.
[*]Fixed video/animation timing issues with high framerates.
[*]Fixed several causes of crashes.[/list]

notes.title: Steam Cloud Sync Enabled
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that Steam Cloud support is now enabled for [u]all[/u] games in the X series, to bring the older games in line with X Rebirth. 

Your savegames will now be synchronised across different PCs using the same Steam account by default. 

If you do not wish to use Steam Cloud to synchronise your games, then right-click on the game in question in the Steam library, choose Properties, go to the Updates tab and uncheck the "Enable Steam Cloud synchronization" checkbox setting. 

You can, of course, re-enable it at any time if you change your mind.

Regards,

[i]Egosoft[/i]

notes.title: Now Available on Linux - X3 Series, 50% off!
notes.notes:
X3: Albion Prelude, X3: Terran Conflict, and X3: Reunion is now available on Linux and to celebrate all X3 packages are 50% off until July 8th!

The X games hurl you into the most detailed universe ever created, right into the middle of an epic, intergalactic story filled with twists and turns at every jump gate. Become the hero once more as you TRADE, FIGHT, BUILD, and THINK your way to victory.

Immerse yourself in a living, breathing universe where all your actions have consequences.

notes.title: X3: Reunion Update Released
notes.notes:
Update 2.5a (05/07/2013) for X3: Reunion has been released.

• Updated several script files to enable compatibility with the Bonus Package DLC
• Minor text display fixes required for support of East Asian languages

notes.title: Surprise! A New X3 Expansion Beams In
notes.notes:
The many skywalking fans of the X series of spaceship shooty-tradey epics are waiting impatiently for X: Rebirth, a full-on sequel/reboot due next year, but now we unexpectedly hear another game will startjump into our orbit before 2011 is done and dusted. X3: Albion Prelude is an expandalandalandalone for X3, and plans to tell the tale of how the X universe transitioned into the state it’s in come Rebirth.
